why: P3 review comments R3.13/R3.14/R3.23 require real image-text pairs; R1.3/R2.3/R3.15/R3.16 require downstream metrics. This manifest uses a fixed sample and is referenced read-only by experiments from _p431 onward.
note_not_karpathy: This split is not the official Karpathy split (that file is not available locally). It is used only for relative comparisons within the same manifest; absolute R@1 must not be compared directly against the literature.

flickr30k.split_rule: sorted(file_name) then numpy default_rng(42).permutation; test=first 1000, val=next 1000, train_pool=rest
